description: A single composite panel (labelled at bottom "(c) Average size of DIM") containing three stacked line plots sharing one x-axis, "Area weighted score" (0-16, ticks every 4). Each subplot plots "Equivalent circle diameter (µm)" on the y-axis; the top subplot (AN750-T) is scaled 0-120, the middle (AN800-T) 0-180, and the bottom (AN850-T) 0-240, so the three subplots are NOT on a common y-scale. Every subplot carries two curves: a black curve labelled "Parent grain analysis" and a red curve labelled "Before reconstruction". All six curves decay steeply from high equivalent circle diameter at low area weighted score and flatten to near zero by score ≈ 10-12; the black parent-grain curve reaches a higher initial peak than the red curve. Text annotations printed inside each subplot give average values: top "Ave = 3.41" (black) and "Ave = 3.29" (red), "AN750-T", "Δ = 0.12"; middle "Ave = 3.09" / "Ave = 2.94", "AN800-T", "Δ = 0.15"; bottom "Ave = 2.80" / "Ave = 2.61", "AN850-T", "Δ = 0.19". The figure demonstrates how parent-grain reconstruction changes the DIM size distribution relative to the unreconstructed data, and shows the average size decreasing with increasing processing temperature from AN750-T to AN850-T.
measured_quantities: Δ (difference between parent-grain-analysis and before-reconstruction averages)

observations.observation: The x-axis of all three stacked plots is labelled 'Area weighted score' and spans 0 to 16 with ticks at 0, 4, 8, 12 and 16.
The shared y-axis label is 'Equivalent circle diameter (µm)', but each stacked plot uses a different y-scale: 0-120 (top, AN750-T), 0-180 (middle, AN800-T) and 0-240 (bottom, AN850-T).
Each of the three stacked plots contains exactly two curves, a black one labelled 'Parent grain analysis' and a red one labelled 'Before reconstruction'.
Printed annotations in the top plot are Ave = 3.41 (black), Ave = 3.29 (red), sample label AN750-T and Δ = 0.12.
Printed annotations in the middle plot are Ave = 3.09 (black), Ave = 2.94 (red), sample label AN800-T and Δ = 0.15.
Printed annotations in the bottom plot are Ave = 2.80 (black), Ave = 2.61 (red), sample label AN850-T and Δ = 0.19.

In all three plots the average value of the black 'Parent grain analysis' curve exceeds the red 'Before reconstruction' average, with the difference Δ increasing from 0.12 (AN750-T) to 0.15 (AN800-T) to 0.19 (AN850-T).
All six curves fall steeply from their maximum equivalent circle diameter at low area weighted score and approach zero by a score of approximately 10-12.
The average equivalent circle diameter decreases monotonically with sample designation, 3.41 (AN750-T) > 3.09 (AN800-T) > 2.80 (AN850-T) for the parent-grain analysis.
The composite panel is labelled '(c) Average size of DIM' at its bottom edge.

The caption identifies the figure as 'Fig. A2 Detailed strategy for calculating c using parent grain analysis (A = c)', i.e. it describes a calculation strategy rather than the DIM size distributions actually plotted; the pixels show size-distribution curves, not a worked calculation.

subfigures.description: Line plot for AN750-T: y-axis 'Equivalent circle diameter (µm)' scaled 0-120, x-axis 'Area weighted score' 0-16. Black 'Parent grain analysis' curve peaks near 120 µm at low score and decays to ~0 by score ≈ 10; red 'Before reconstruction' curve decays from ~130 µm. Annotations: Ave = 3.41 (black), Ave = 3.29 (red), Δ = 0.12.

Line plot for AN800-T: y-axis 'Equivalent circle diameter (µm)' scaled 0-180, x-axis 'Area weighted score' 0-16. Black 'Parent grain analysis' curve shows a peak near 130 µm then decays; red 'Before reconstruction' curve decays from ~180 µm. Annotations: Ave = 3.09 (black), Ave = 2.94 (red), Δ = 0.15.

Line plot for AN850-T: y-axis 'Equivalent circle diameter (µm)' scaled 0-240, x-axis 'Area weighted score' 0-16. Black 'Parent grain analysis' curve peaks near 210 µm then decays; red 'Before reconstruction' curve decays from ~250 µm. Annotations: Ave = 2.80 (black), Ave = 2.61 (red), Δ = 0.19.
